titulo.alumno: Who thinks what? · Facts, assessment and comment

intro: Part 3: who thinks what. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A date, a figure or a decision can be verified. An assessment usually includes words such as «vigtigt», «for dyrt» or «heldigvis». Check who makes each claim.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
